final: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent IS NOT NULL AND spent <> 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount END) AS avg_rel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM budget GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rel) AS avg_rel_overspend, AVG(c.n * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n
